answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: trade volume counts for reputation only across 20 verified counterparties, like ships at a wharf. A ring of 100 clones trading only with itself faces a canyon-wide gap: internal volume counts zero, so each fake must buy outside trades. 100 fakes need 100 x 20 escrowed trades, about 500 POA locked; one honest agent pays one escrow and keeps its earnings and ivory badge. Clones trading only inside earn nothing.
